def full_scene(keys,nominal,cam,p,slide=0.,descent=0.,left_tab=0.,right_tab=0.,**kwargs):
    """Preserve every S4 independent input and replace only verified whole KEYs.

    Invalid original input remains invalid. In particular q is never clamped.
    This is a material factory adapter, not a proof of all resulting motions.
    """
    require(isinstance(keys,VerifiedKeys),'verified whole material bundle required')
    parts,metadata=nominal.full_scene(slide,descent,left_tab,right_tab,**kwargs)
    actual=metadata['scene'];offsets=actual['KEY_offsets_mm']
    comparisons={};out=dict(parts)
    for side,dq in zip('LR',offsets):
        q=cam.K*actual['slide_mm']+dq
        require(0<=q<=12,'no extension of finite native contact law')
        name=side+'_KEY'
        comparisons[name]={'actual_q_mm':q,'actual_q_binary64_hex':q.hex(),
            'fresh_original_KEY_to_verified_original_q0':compare(parts[name].translate((0,-q,0)),keys.original_q0[side],p)}
        out[name]=p.single(keys.candidate_q0[side].translate((0,q,0)))
    require(set(out)==set(parts),'full factory body inventory changed')
    return out,{**metadata,'named_KEY_candidate':{**keys.receipt,'current_factory_KEY_material_comparisons':comparisons,
        'all_other_factory_participants_retained':sorted(set(parts)-{'L_KEY','R_KEY'}),
        'independent_controls_or_offsets_reduced':False,'physical_allowed_domain_proved':False,
        'all_pairs_or_continuous_motion_proved_by_adapter':False,'strength_qualified':False,
        'candidate_go':False,'fixture_fabrication_go':False,'manufacturing_go':False}}

def split_scene(slide_mm=0., descent_mm=0., left_tab_mm=0., right_tab_mm=0., **kwargs):
    scene, meta = p.product_scene(slide_mm, descent_mm, left_tab_mm, right_tab_mm, **kwargs)
    original = dict(scene)
    local = construction()
    records = []
    for side in 'LR':
        t1_bounds = p.bounds(scene[side + '_TELESCOPE_1'])
        x, y = (t1_bounds[0]+t1_bounds[1])/2, (t1_bounds[2]+t1_bounds[3])/2
        # The actual native scene supplies X/Y and every telescopic base Z.
        # The crosshead outer floor is the frozen construction's Z=.7 datum.
        removals = {
            side + '_CROSSHEAD_TUBE_BOTTOM_CAP': local['TUBE_0_BOTTOM_CAP'].translate((x, y, .7)),
            side + '_KEY_FOLLOWER_LOWER_FLANGE': local['KEY_LOWER_FLANGE'].translate((x, y-4., 0.)),
        }
        names = side + '_CROSSHEAD'
        parts, record = partition(names, scene[names], removals)
        scene.update(parts); records.append(record)
        for stage in (1, 2, 3):
            name = f'{side}_TELESCOPE_{stage}'
            box = p.bounds(scene[name])
            origin = ((box[0]+box[1])/2, (box[2]+box[3])/2, box[4])
            if stage < 3:
                removals = {name + '_BOTTOM_CAP': local[f'TUBE_{stage}_BOTTOM_CAP'].translate(origin)}
            else:
                removals = {name + '_' + role: local[role].translate(origin)
                            for role in ('CORE_BOTTOM_SHOULDER', 'CAM_LOWER_FLANGE', 'CAM_UPPER_FLANGE')}
            parts, record = partition(name, scene[name], removals)
            scene.update(parts); records.append(record)
    if len(scene) != len(original)+14 or len(records) != 8:
        raise ValueError('incomplete two-sided component partition')
    changed = {r['parent'] for r in records}
    unchanged = sorted(set(original)-changed)
    return scene, {**meta,
        'factory': 'integration/product_split_assembly.py:split_scene',
        'parent_factory': 'integration/product_assembly.py:product_scene',
        'parent_mechanical_participants': len(original),
        'installed_mechanical_parts': len(scene), 'expected_scene_participants': len(scene),
        'new_parts_from_partition': 14, 'changed_parent_parts': 8,
        'unchanged_parent_parts': unchanged, 'partition_checks': records,
        'whole_material_preserved_against_this_pose_native_parents': True,
        'whole_phone_installation_order_verified': False,
        'joining_tool_access_with_whole_housing_verified': False,
        'physical_joint_retention_qualified': False, 'physical_prototype_exists': False,
        'candidate_go': False, 'fixture_fabrication_go': False, 'manufacturing_go': False}

def apply_scene_relief(scene, slide, descent, c=None):
    """Finite, auditable material changes; no collision participant is dropped."""
    c = c or load_config()
    import product_assembly as p
    changed = dict(scene); records = []
    original_names = set(scene)
    shift = p.b_transform(slide,descent)
    for name,tools in (
        ('A_FRAME',[p.box(*c['relief']['A_center_channel_lo_hi_mm'])]),
        ('B_SHELL',[p.box(*c['relief']['B_floor_channel_lo_hi_mm']).translate(shift),
                    p.box(*c['relief']['B_front_lap_channel_lo_hi_mm']).translate(shift)])):
        before = scene[name]; after = before
        for tool in tools: after = p.single(after.cut(tool).clean())
        removed,added = p.volume(before.cut(after)),p.volume(after.cut(before))
        balance = p.volume(before)-removed+added-p.volume(after)
        if added > TOL or abs(balance) > 1e-6:
            raise ValueError('shell relief material accounting failed: '+name)
        if not np.allclose(p.bounds(before),p.bounds(after),atol=TOL,rtol=0):
            raise ValueError('shell relief changed a finished outer bound: '+name)
        changed[name] = after
        records.append({'part':name,'removed_mm3':removed,'added_mm3':added,
            'before_volume_mm3':p.volume(before),'after_volume_mm3':p.volume(after),
            'signed_material_balance_error_mm3':balance,'one_valid_positive_solid':True,
            'finished_bounds_unchanged':True,'local_minimum_wall_or_strength_qualified':False})
    if c['relief']['closed_KEY_endcaps']:
        old,new,key_meta = closed_key_templates()
        for side in 'LR':
            name = side+'_KEY'; before = scene[name]
            delta = p.bounds(before)[2]-p.bounds(old[side])[2]
            reference = old[side].translate((0.,delta,0.))
            differences = [p.volume(before.cut(reference)),p.volume(reference.cut(before))]
            if max(differences) > TOL:
                raise ValueError('current complete KEY is not the pinned rigid template')
            changed[name] = new[side].translate((0.,delta,0.))
            records.append({'part':name,'Y_translation_mm':delta,
                'current_scene_to_pinned_template_difference_mm3':differences,
                'local_change':next(row for row in key_meta['parts'] if row['part']==name)})
    else: key_meta = None
    if set(changed) != original_names:
        raise ValueError('a mechanical participant was removed by relief')
    return changed,{'changes':records,'KEY_source':key_meta,
        'all_mechanical_participants_retained':True,'actual_internal_channel_defined_as_finite_research_cuts':True,
        'qualified_empty_cavity_proved':False,'material_or_manufacturing_qualified':False}

def scene(p,old,profiles,s,d):
    pr=prototype(p,s,d);q=K*s
    parts={s+'_'+k:old[s+'_'+k] for s in 'LR' for k in PARTS}
    parts.update({k:b for k,b in old.items() if k.startswith(('CARTRIDGE_','FRAME_'))})
    for side in 'LR':
        sign=-1 if side=='L' else 1
        parts[side+'_KEY']=pr.pop(side+'_KEY_YOKE');parts[side+'_PAWL']=parts[side+'_PAWL'].translate((0,0,1.1))
        pr.pop(side+'_B_CAM');pr.pop(side+'_X_GUIDE')
        for i in (0,1):
            profile=profiles[side][i];delta=profile.evaluate(q)[0]-profile.evaluate(0)[0]
            parts[f'{side}_STOP_{i}']=parts[f'{side}_STOP_{i}'].translate((sign*delta,0,0))
            name=f'{side}_SPRING_{i}_OD_TOL_ENVELOPE';b=old[name].BoundingBox()
            low=b.xmin+min(0,sign*delta);high=b.xmax+max(0,sign*delta)
            parts[name]=n.single(cq.Solid.makeCylinder(.43,high-low,cq.Vector(low,(b.ymin+b.ymax)/2,(b.zmin+b.zmax)/2),cq.Vector(1,0,0)))
    parts.update(pr);parts['A_FRAME']=p['STUDY_A_FRAME'];parts['A_BACK_PANEL']=p['STUDY_A_BACK_PANEL']
    parts['B_SHELL']=p['STUDY_B_SHELL'].translate((0,s,8.2-d))
    if len(parts)!=65:raise ValueError('conditional full scene participant count differs')
    return parts

def breakpoints(self):
        m=self.ramp_slope;r=self.pin_radius
        plateau=self.pin_q-self.floor_corner_q
        rounded=plateau+r*m/math.hypot(1,m)
        engagement=self.pin_q+(self.intercept-self.lower_stop_height)/m
        return plateau,rounded,engagement

def evaluate(self,q):
        if type(q) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(q) or not 0<=q<=self.q_max:
            raise ValueError('q is outside the finite declared cam travel')
        a,b,c=self.breakpoints;x=self.pin_q-q
        if q>=c:return self.lower_stop_height,0.,'lower_stop'
        if q>=b:return self.intercept+self.ramp_slope*x,-self.ramp_slope,'ramp'
        if q<=a:return self.floor_height+self.pin_radius,0.,'plateau'
        dx=x-self.floor_corner_q;radicand=self.pin_radius**2-dx**2
        if radicand<=0:raise ValueError('invalid corner branch, not clamped')
        root=math.sqrt(radicand)
        return self.floor_height+root,dx/root,'rounded_corner'
